CustomObject.label: Business Entity
CustomObject.description: One row per reseller (Business Entity), keyed by the same Reseller__c picklist value already used on Account.Reseller_Name__c and Subscription25__Administration__c.Reseller__c - joined by value, not by lookup, so this object has no dependency on the Subscription25 managed package. Currently used to configure Dealer Shop shipping cost behaviour per reseller.
